title: VCS React Parity
description: Restore the VCS technology's premigration UI (git tag `premigration`, f8376e84) to the current Rust-plugin → UiNode → React-renderer architecture: the SVG ancestor graph (swimlanes, elbow connectors, commit nodes, author avatars, label chips) in the History window, and the action-button editor surface (+Counter, Commit checkpoint, Undo, Redo, New alternative). Prerequisite: port fork semantics (current_checkpoint_id tracking) into vcs/rs DocumentVcsStore, since HEAD's store cannot branch. Add SurfaceKind::VcsHistory + VcsHistoryScene + VcsHistoryHost, port the premigration lane-assignment algorithm into vcs/rs, restore HistoryTable into ui/js/react/index.tsx, richer seed history with real forks, and a vcs-react-dev launch.json entry.
summary:
Restored the VCS technology's premigration UI to the current Rust-plugin → UiNode → React-renderer architecture.

Prerequisite fix: `vcs/rs` DocumentVcsStore could not fork (CommitCheckpoint always parented on the vector tail, CheckoutCheckpoint never changed the parent pointer). Added `current_checkpoint_id` tracking through CommitCheckpoint/CreateAlternative/SwitchAlternative/CheckoutCheckpoint, mirroring premigration's `checkoutCheckpointInternal` semantics, with a getter/setter so the plugin can persist checkout position across its per-action envelope round-trip.

Ported the premigration lane-assignment algorithm (`assignHistoryCheckpointLanes`/`buildHistoryColumns`) into `vcs/rs` as `HistoryColumn` + `build_history_columns`.

Added a dedicated `SurfaceKind::VcsHistory` + `VcsHistoryScene` to `framework/core/rs` (struct-update builder pattern, no signature fallout), wired through `framework/renderer/react` (os-shell.tsx mirror, ui-interpreter.tsx case, new `vcs-history-host.tsx`), and restored the `HistoryTable` SVG ancestor-graph component (swimlanes, elbow connectors, commit nodes, author avatars, label chips) into `ui/js/react/index.tsx` next to `TableAvatar`.

Rewrote `vcs/plugin/rs`: history render now emits `VcsHistoryScene` via the ported lane algorithm (replacing a bogus `lane: alternative_ids.len()`); editor surface replaced the raw JSON text editor with a declarative button UI (+Counter, Commit, Branch, Undo, Redo) split across three rows — discovered and worked around a framework window-chrome quirk where Canvas2d-kind windows overlap content flush at the panel top with an "Action/Viewport" tab toggle, and where the shared horizontal-stack renderer gives every button an equal flex-1 share without shrinking, causing 5 long-label buttons in one row to overlap; ported the full premigration seed (15 checkpoints, 5 alternatives with real forks: feature-a, feature-b, feature-a-hotfix, docs, spike).

Added `vcs-react-dev` to `.claude/launch.json` (port 6075).

Verified: all Rust tests pass (vcs, vcs-plugin, semio-framework-core), all TS/vitest tests pass (framework/renderer/react, ui/js/react), WASM plugin builds cleanly, and live browser verification confirmed the full ancestor graph (15 rows, correct lanes/elbows/chips/avatars), all 5 editor buttons functional, and a live checkout→increment→commit fork correctly creating a new branch with the right parent connector.
